page.overview:
Who is Krokodils?

Krokodils are a -like, crocodile-themed robot which appears in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2: Battle Nexus. They inhabit the sewers near the ' , prior to their fight against . They fight very similar to Mousers, but do far more damage and are more durable.

Krokodils also appear in the Open Brawl and Battle Nexus tournaments.
